title: Signatura Rerum, the Signature of All Things
author: Jakob Bohme
description: Jakob Bohme considers the visible world as an expression of deeper spiritual qualities. The work explores signatures in nature, connecting outward forms with an inward account of creation and divine life.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/signaturarerumor00bhme).
